records.title: The relation of whole-body nitrogen elimination during prebreathe to the incidence of decompression sickness at 4.3 psia
records.note: Ten men each had measurements in at least three of the same four conditions. SHR and HDR counts and the SE2 numerator match Abstract 71. This report contributes methods and the demonstrated use of measured washout, with no downloadable individual washout values.
